parameters.query:
SELECT 
  c.conversation_id,
  c.contact_id,
  c.property_id,
  c.conversation_stage,
  c.conversation_history,
  c.collected_data,
  c.updated_at,
  p.property_name,
  p.property_type,
  p.base_price,
  p.max_guests,
  p.bedrooms,
  p.amenities,
  p.house_rules,
  p.check_in_time,
  p.check_out_time,
  p.location_description,
  p.owner_name,
  p.preferred_platform
FROM conversations c
LEFT JOIN property_configurations p ON c.property_id = p.property_id
WHERE c.contact_id = $1
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 1
